limitations: This collection took no part in deriving the thresholds it is measured against; those were fixed in commit 1b1a0c7 from collections 2, 3 and 4 before this one was acquired. It is one independent check, not a demonstration that the thresholds hold in general.
Seam gradient is evaluated only at hard-cut source transitions and is compared with every covered same-owner adjacency in the same raster and directions.
No structural-edge displacement metric is reported: the former argmax proxy was not discriminative on this wall texture.
Pixels outside the frozen coverage_region are not required by the acceptance gate; their planned-SCAN and safe-pose classifications are explanatory, not additional pass criteria.

The planned-SCAN footprint is the continuous geometric sweep of the frozen task, not proof that every planned point produced a stored image; coverage_count.tif remains the authority for actual capture.

The safe-pose envelope proves geometric existence of a base_link centre in the frozen motion_region at an allowed scan-axis heading; it does not claim the frozen plan visited that pose. Its outside count is zero by construction, because the mosaic domain lies wholly inside that envelope.

The reported scale error carries a pipeline systematic of about +21 ppm, isotropic and reproducible across collections to within 2 ppm, localised upstream of the pose graph to the camera model and resampling chain. It is not an acquisition-condition effect and is not removed here.

The vertical sweep was re-run after a first attempt was refused by the capture guard: the simulator stalled for 1.91 s and the next exposure landed 156 mm past its target. The partial archive was discarded, not repaired.
